title: Short, strange-looking police officer escorts Michael off restricted land

tellings.quote: He was short. He was short. Face was puffy. He had a hat on. Deputy dog kind of hat like a deputy dog kind of hat from cartoons and stuff.

plain: In 1977, on restricted government land in Nevada, a short police officer with a puffy face and a hat like the one worn by the cartoon character Deputy Dawg walked a man named Michael off the property. Michael, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted, tells it as something he lived through. It belongs to his larger story of a trucker's UFO sighting and lost time on a drive from Texas to that Nevada land, and he tells it because the officer seemed strange to him.
